package postgres

import (
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestMigration027PreservesV1AndMakesPracticeV2ClosureTerminal(t *testing.T) {
	payload, err := os.ReadFile("../../../../db/migrations/027_practice_learning_action_evidence_v2.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	sql := string(payload)
	for _, expected := range []string{
		"policy_version = 'practice-competency-evidence-v1'",
		"policy_version = 'practice-competency-evidence-v2'",
		"fk_student_practice_evidence_receipt_learning_action",
		"uq_student_practice_evidence_receipt_learning_action_v2",
		"lifecycle_status IN ('RESERVED', 'OPEN', 'CANCELLED', 'CLOSED')",
		"OLD.lifecycle_status = 'OPEN' AND NEW.lifecycle_status NOT IN ('OPEN', 'CANCELLED', 'CLOSED')",
		"terminal practice learning action is immutable",
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(sql, expected) {
			t.Fatalf("migration 025 is missing %q", expected)
		}
	}
}
